description: Restyle the language menu so it looks like part of the site. Read the site's brand color, background, text color, button roundness and dark mode first, then send only the fields to change in `style`. Colors: #hex, rgb(), hsl() or a CSS color name; each has a Light and a Dark version. Full field list: https://proxylang.dev/agents.md step 7.

style.description: Fields to change, e.g. {"accent": "#0a7cff", "triggerBgLight": "#ffffff", "triggerTextLight": "#111827", "borderRadius": "pill"}. Fields: triggerBg/triggerText/triggerHover/dropdownBg/dropdownText/bg/text/border + Light|Dark, accent, accentText, borderRadius (rounded|pill|square), size (small|medium|large), dropdownSize, shadowStrength (none|light|medium|strong), glassmorphism, position, displayFormat (code|native|both), flagStyle (none|rectangle|square|circle), animation, darkModeMethod (auto|class), darkModeClass.

name: proxylang_style
title: Match the language menu to the site
